name: L10 PanoLab lexical-reachability to appearance-candidate router
question: After extending target-linked reference coverage from three to all four fresh active-view targets, can a component router replace lexical UNKNOWN with a correct after-frame appearance search-priority candidate while preserving zero wrong-goal candidates and zero portal-ownership bindings?

source_authority.consumed_scope: All eight fresh query panoramas, the fixed lexical result, and six references for FL01/FL03/FL04 were already consumed. The two Le Viviani reference pixels were frozen and materialized without pixel/model access but do not make the whole four-target replay fresh.
source_authority.new_source: Le Viviani reference selection had zero exact query-item overlap, zero pre-freeze selected-pixel views, zero pre-freeze model calls, and two successfully hashed 5760x2880 images.
source_authority.pre_model_transport_correction: The first invocation stopped before model loading because the FL04 near-reference ID accidentally combined the e713c126 prefix with another item's suffix. The incomplete task-owned crop directory was removed, the ID was corrected to the exact frozen node-credential item, and no model, score, weight, gate, query, roster, or selection rule changed.
source_authority.same_provider_boundary: Every query and reference is Panoramax. Six of eight references share the query collection for their target; collection-disjointness is reported per reference and no provider-disjoint generalization is claimed.
source_authority.closed_roster: The requested target is always one of four OSM-linked entities with a two-view reference bank. Target-absent and open-world rejection are not evaluated.

observation_window.anchor: strict OSM entrance ray under the unchanged zero-pose Panoramax contract
observation_window.sampling: native equirectangular pixels with horizontal seam wrap and no resampling

appearance_score.formula: For each candidate target: 0.35 * maximum CLIP reference cosine + 0.25 * maximum pooled DINOv2 reference cosine + 0.40 * maximum mutual-patch affine-consistency score.
appearance_score.change_control: Models, weights, patch grid, entrance window and local-geometry formula are copied unchanged. The failed two-frame max bank is not used; only the independently DIRECT after frame is scored.

router.lexical_first: If the frozen long-short exact-token bank matched the requested target, retain LEXICAL_CANDIDATE.
router.appearance_fallback: Otherwise emit APPEARANCE_SEARCH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE only when the requested target is unique top-1 in the fixed four-target reference roster and its margin is positive; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
router.counterfactuals: For each query, replay all three other roster identities as wrong requested goals. A wrong goal receives a search-priority candidate only if it is top-1 for that query.
router.authority: Both branches emit candidates for observation/search prioritization only. Neither may bind a pixel region, facade, sign, door, portal, or entrance to the requested entity.

execution.backend_rule: Use the existing project CPU/CUDA representative probe once, then keep its selected backend for all twelve crops.
execution.overwrite: Refuse an existing output or artifact root.

gate.stop_rule: Run once. If the gate fails, do not tune the consumed queries, model weights, score formula, reference choices or candidate rule. Change the source or collect a genuinely new cohort.

research_basis.title: Learning Sequential Descriptors for Sequence-based Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Sequence VPR motivates testing temporal aggregation, but the local one-edge replay showed no gain; the router therefore spends appearance compute only on the independently useful DIRECT after frame.

research_basis.title: JIST: Joint Image and Sequence Training for Sequential Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: JIST motivates learned temporal aggregation as a future genuinely new model/source route. This deterministic router does not implement SeqGeM or claim benchmark comparability.

claim_boundary.allowed: Source-extended, post-hoc Development evidence on four Panoramax episodes about replacing a frozen lexical UNKNOWN with a closed-roster appearance search-priority candidate while retaining explicit UNKNOWN and zero ownership bindings.
not_allowed: fresh, blind, open-world, target-absent, source-provider-disjoint, or broad generalization evidence
a top-1 appearance candidate being exact-instance, address, sign, facade, portal, or entrance ownership
appearance authorizing the independently projected OSM entrance ray
entrance affordance, public or legal access, walkability, or collision-free traversability
waypoint accuracy, metric localization, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
